thread:
anna: Heads-up — one of our CS reps forwarded an email from external sender to a few folks. Attachment `invoice_2026.xlsm` had macros. User says they didn't open it but forwarded it. Can security triage? :warning:

samir: thanks. can you paste the full headers and the sender address? also which user forwarded it?

anna: forwarded by carla (carla@redwood-cs). headers below:
```
From: invoice-service@outsider[.]com
To: carla@redwood.com
Subject: Invoice 2026
Received: from mx.outsider.com (88.198.45.123)
X-Mailer: MessageSender 3.2
```

sandbox-bot: analysis queued (id=sbx-2026-451) — sample `invoice_2026.xlsm` uploaded to sandbox.

sandbox-bot: analysis complete — score: HIGH. Observed behavior:
- drops `%TEMP%\\svchost.exe`
- spawns obfuscated PowerShell and attempts `hxxp://88[.]198[.]45[.]123/payload.exe`
- tries to add persistence via scheduled task `UpdaterSvc`

IOCs:
```
88.198.45.123
hxxp://88[.]198[.]45[.]123/payload.exe
invoice-service@outsider.com
UpdaterSvc
```

elaine: containment actions taken: blocked sender domain at gateway, removed attachment from internal shares and the user's Sent items copy, disabled external forwarding rule on Carla's mailbox as a precaution. Asked Carla to disconnect device from VPN and not to power it back on until IT checks. :eyes: We also uploaded sandbox report to secure storage.

it-oncall: did a host triage on Carla's machine — ran CrowdStrike full scan + process timeline. No `svchost.exe` in %TEMP% and no scheduled task named `UpdaterSvc` found. No suspicious outbound connections in the last 24h.

samir: good. still treat as confirmed malicious sample. Actions I'm taking: 1) add IOCs to SIEM blocklist and to firewall URL denylist, 2) create detection rule to flag macro-enabled attachments from external senders and quarantine, 3) open an incident ticket (INC-2026-451) and assign to eng-security for follow-ups.

marta: I'll handle comms with the CS team and draft an awareness blurb for tomorrow's digest. Also will follow up with Carla to confirm she didn't interact with the file contents. :thumbsup:

anna: Carla confirms she only clicked forward in the client UI and did not open the attachment. She forwarded to 3 internal addresses. I've DM'd those people to check and asked them to run AV scan.

elaine: post-incident items for the playbook: 1) ensure sandbox report retention to secure KMS-encrypted bucket, 2) record mailbox and event logs to audit store (90d retention), 3) update phishing playbook step to force automatic quarantine of macro-enabled Office attachments from external domains.

samir: please also add the sender domain to org-level spam filter denylist and create an automated rule in SIEM to alert on any users receiving messages with these IOCs. I'll add the new detection rule to the repo and request infra review for deployment.

marta: noted — will include recommended training link for Carla + team.

anna: thanks all. reopening if any new detections show up. otherwise close in 48h. :white_check_mark:
